newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Computer monitor maker to kick off IPO in HK soon.
newsitem.headline: Computer monitor maker to kick off IPO in HK soon.

text.p: Colour and monochrome computer monitor manufacturer and distributor Proview International Holdings Ltd is expected to kick off its initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong next week, analysts said.

"The IPO is expected to be kicked off early next week but further listing details, such as size and value of the issue, are not yet available to the market," said one analyst after attended a company presentation on Friday.
The company has manufacturing facilities in China and a research and development centre in Taiwan, analysts said.
"Most of the company's monitor products are for export to Europe and to the United States," another analyst said.
Lippo Securities is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, analysts said.
Proview is expected to hold a press briefing on Tuesday to disclose its flotation plan.
